Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world. Visit our website at www.cleanspark.com. Working closely with the Land & Power team, this role researches emerging markets, identifies available utility capacity, evaluates industrial and commercial land opportunities, and develops relationships with utilities, brokers, landowners, developers, and economic development organizations to build a pipeline of qualified development opportunities. The Development Associate supports the early stages of the land and power development lifecycle by conducting market research, coordinating preliminary site evaluations and due diligence activities, and advancing opportunities for review by the broader Land & Power team. title: Manager of Utility & Energy
description: Job Overview The Manager of Utility & Energy owns CleanSpark's utility relationships and energy pathway. The Manager serves both the inbound and outbound sides of the Land & Power team, informing site selection with utility capacity and queue insight and supporting power-related diligence across the portfolio. Success in this role requires deep utility fluency, negotiation skill, and disciplined cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced environment.
